Container.Name: Seryn
Container.Overview: Seryn is a self-hosted planner for expected income and expenses.
Container.Description:
Seryn runs as one ASP.NET Core container with SQLite, sessions, and encryption keys persisted under /data.
Before the first start, set a unique 16–128 character administrator password. The password provisions a new database only; it never resets an existing account. The appdata directory must be owned by UID/GID 1654: run `chown 1654:1654 /mnt/user/appdata/seryn` on the Unraid host before starting.
For reverse-proxy access, enable HTTPS and set the exact proxy address. Direct LAN access with HTTPS disabled sends credentials without transport encryption.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host port for the Seryn web interface.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: SQLite, sessions, and encryption keys. Must be owned by UID/GID 1654.

Config.Name: Initial administrator user
Config.Description: Used only when the data directory has no existing administrator.

Config.Name: Initial administrator password
Config.Description: Required on first start. Use a unique 16–128 character password; it is never used to reset an existing account.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Use the public hostname or * when Seryn is accessed through the Unraid IP.

Config.Name: Require HTTPS
Config.Description: Set true behind an HTTPS reverse proxy. Leave false only for trusted LAN or Tailscale access.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy
Config.Description: Exact IP address of the reverse proxy as seen by the container. Keep 127.0.0.1 when no proxy is used.
